profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I graduated from Iowa State University.
I have a Bachelors of Science in Computer Engineering.
I am very proficient at swing dancing.

positions.title: Student Worker
positions.description:
For the fall semester of 2013, I worked 8 hours a week cleaning and stocking.  For the Fall 2013 Football season I worked on average 12.5 hours a week, from my shift on Saturday working at the Stadium, making and delivering pizzas to the other Suites' grills.  My main job involved continuous service so I have to be efficient and plan ahead in order to get everything done and not cause a mess or a jam.   The Stadium shift is more about deadlines, because we have to get the pizzas to all the grills for certain points in the Game.
For the spring semester of 2014, I work about 10 hours a week with duties including making pizzas, cleaning, doing the laundry, and washing dishes.

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description: An outdated SQL database server was running under an outdated version of some Flexera software.  That Flexera software was running under Trane's custom software.  The Flexera software was responsible for upgrading the database, but the upgrade script failed.  Since the support on the software was already expired, I had to figure out how to upgrade the database server to run under the most recent version of Flexera software.  I was able to learn some C# and some SQL, and now Trane's software is running on top of the current versions of that Flexera software and a current version of the SQL database server.

positions.title: Customer Services Representative in Concessions and Ticket Sales
positions.description: I am a customer services representative.  I cheerfully selling tickets and concessions to the customers.   I have to be efficient in calculating the customers orders.  Another part of my position is cleaning up during and after the movie.  Then during the movie, I have to analyze how much stuff I  have to get done with how much I can do to efficiently manage my time during the movie to clean up the lobby area.

honors.title: Eagle Scout
honors.issuer: Issued by Boy Scouts of America · Nov 2011
